{{Quote|Lieutenant Sykes, glad you made it. You've been well-trained.|Captain Panaka, to Gavyn Sykes, after the latter destroys attacking hostiles near Rasker Hill|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
A '''battle''' took place near the [[South ridge of Theed|south ridge]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet in response to a [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|trade dispute]]. The battle occurred just after Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] and her head of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], returned to the planet and gathered local [[Naboo Resistance|resistance]] leaders to brief them on their plan to retake the planet from the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] forces attacked members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] near [[Rasker Hill]], but they were driven off by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], a member of Naboo's [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]], whose quick actions saved nearby [[Farm/Legends|farms]]. Panaka met with Sykes and ordered him to guard the south ridge.

Shortly thereafter, Sykes spotted a large Trade Federation [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]], which was preparing to depart for flanking maneuvers on the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]] against the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]]. He then responded to a distress call from fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Palmer (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|Palmer]] at the [[Naboo airbase]]. After Sykes destroyed the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], [[Trade Federation droid bomber|droid bombers]], and [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]] that threatened the airbase, Panaka ordered him to intercept the convoy in a [[NB-1S Royal Bomber|bomber]]. During his assault on the convoy, Sykes also destroyed the [[Trade Federation Airbase]]. He delayed the convoy's [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] and [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] in [[Widow's Valley]] so that Panaka could place [[Thermal detonator/Legends|explosives]] on a [[bridge]] in the convoy's path. When the explosives failed, Sykes [[Proton bomb/Legends|bombed]] the bridge and destroyed the rest of the convoy in the process.

==Prelude==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] returned to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after fleeing the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> In her absence, the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] had been fighting a desperate battle against the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], and her return united them. Under her guidance, the [[Naboo Resistance]] came up with a [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|plan]] to end the enemy occupation of their world. To that end, Amidala gathered as many resistance [[Officer/Legends|officers]] as she could and [[Battle of the Sacred Place|secured the help]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], Naboo's other major [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Gungans agreed to serve as a diversion for the Queen's plan and gathered their [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Grand Army]] for the planned assault on the Federation forces. The Trade Federation noticed the Gungan forces gathering in the swamps near [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], and sent its own [[Army/Legends|army]] to wipe out the insurgency before it threatened their interests.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace novelization" /> After [[Liberation of enslavement camps|their]] [[Attack on Porso Hill|successes]] [[Liberation of Camp Four|in battle]], the resistance cell, led by Naboo's [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], joined Amidala at the [[south ridge of Theed]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==The battle==
===The gathering===
{{Quote|Panaka? Maybe he can get us organized.''"<br />"''We need to locate him first. Let's move.|A Naboo soldier and Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
[[File:BFN_south_ridge.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Sykes in a Gian speeder attacking Federation STAPs near Rasker Hill]]

After the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] meeting with the Gungans, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] sent out a message on the coded Royal Security Forces emergency frequency, directing all officers who received the message to rendezvous on [[Rasker Hill]], near the south ridge. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Sykes, in a [[V-19 landspeeder|Gian speeder]], and other members of his resistance cell in a [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|''Seraph''-class speeder]], received the message. Shortly thereafter, Panaka came under attack and informed the approaching reinforcements via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
Trade Federation [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] (STAPs) and two [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] attacked civilians and resistance members at the south ridge. Sykes's resistance cell joined Panaka, who was in a Gian [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]], to fight off the Trade Federation forces. After the first group of STAPs were destroyed, another small group of STAPs appeared near Rasker Hill and were quickly defeated by the Naboo fighters. The resistance's quick actions saved nearby [[Farm/Legends|farms]] from destruction, although some farms did sustain damage.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

The three Naboo speeders then met on top of Rasker Hill, where Panaka praised Sykes's training and explained the strategy by which the Naboo forces would free the planet. He ordered Sykes to take his forces to guard the rear entrance of Theed to prepare for the next battle, and to then to follow the Captain. Sykes, in turn, ordered the third speeder to head to the south ridge. Panaka and Sykes drove off Rasker Hill and parked nearby, with Panaka dismounting to continue his briefing. He reminded Sykes to call him on the coded secure emergency frequency if there was trouble and wished the Lieutenant good luck. As Sykes departed to comply with the Captain's orders, he gave his word that he would cover the Captain.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

===South ridge===
{{Quote|This is Palmer on the southern ridge. We've picked up Trade Federation forces moving our way, fast.|Palmer|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
[[File:BFN_resistance_base.jpg|thumb|right|300px||Sykes engaging Federation tanks at the resistance camp]]
Meanwhile, a large Trade Federation [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]]<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> designated [[Army C]] had entered the south ridge en route to the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]] to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|engage]] the Gungan Grand Army in a flanking maneuver.<ref name="NEGTVAV">This battle was given an indirect mention in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' in the entry for the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].</ref> Upon reaching the area, Sykes contacted Panaka to inform him the south ridge was compromised; in turn, Panaka ordered Sykes to gather his forces to intercept the convoy. Sykes, still driving his Gian speeder, pursued the convoy, but a collapsing pillar landed on a trailing Trade Federation [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] (AAT) and blocked his path. Simultaneously, the Trade Federation attacked the Naboo [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] at the south ridge proper; a soldier named [[Palmer (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|Palmer]] contacted Sykes to inform him of the attack. As two [[Trade Federation droid bomber|droid bombers]] and a group of AATs headed toward the [[Naboo airbase]], Sykes raced off to help. En route, he destroyed two static [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]] and shot down the [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. By that point, the AATs had made it to the base. When Palmer radioed again, Sykes responded that he was on his way; he moved in and saved the base from the attacking AATs<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> and prevented the base from experiencing heavy casualties.<ref name="Casualties" /> Two [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] and a ''Seraph''-class speeder were parked at the base at that [[Time/Legends|time]]. Panaka ordered Sykes to switch craft at the base's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] to stop the convoy, and Sykes took an experimental [[NB-1S Royal Bomber|bomber]] for the attack.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
Sykes approached the convoy after [[airborne mine]]s and [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter cover]] placed in the way failed to stop him. He dropped [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bombs]] on three staging areas, causing much damage to the Federation forces. The [[Trade Federation Airbase]] was meanwhile preparing to launch an attack, which Panaka warned him about. Sykes flew in to destroy the base, dedicating its destruction to his Queen. Even though the staging areas were now compromised, he still had to deal with the convoy's remaining [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] and [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], which were still moving toward its target. As he and the convoy passed into [[Widow's Valley]], Palmer told him to watch out for the valley's unstable pillars. To further delay the convoy, Sykes started knocking down the pillars. [[Laser/Legends|Laser]] turrets placed near the Federation installations and in the valley fired at Sykes, who responded by launching a proton bomb. As Sykes flew into Widow's Valley, Panaka informed him that they had spotted a [[bridge]] ahead of the convoy and were going to destroy it. As the convoy neared the bridge, situated over a [[Unidentified Naboo canyon|canyon]], a Naboo speeder dropped off [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], which subsequently failed to go off. Just before the convoy reached the end of the bridge, Sykes dropped one of his bombs on the bridge, which went up in a large explosion along with the remainder of the convoy.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

With the convoy destroyed, Panaka congratulated Sykes again and told him to report to Theed, where a speeder awaited him.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|That was close, but good work, Lieutenant. If that convoy had reached the city, we'd be finished. We have a speeder waiting for you at the south gate. Meet us there.|Panaka, to Sykes, after the destruction of the convoy|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
With the destruction of the Trade Federation Droid Army's flanking force in the area,<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> the Gungans were able to hold out long enough for the Queen to enter Theed and launch her N-1 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the Federation's [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] over Naboo.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace novelization" /> After destroying the convoy, Sykes joined the battle to retake Theed, leading diversionary forces before jumping into an N-1. In [[Realspace/Legends|space]], his [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|actions]] allowed the young [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to destroy the Federation [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] from the inside. The destruction of the Droid Control Ship shut down the Trade Federation Army<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> and brought an end to the invasion after Amidala and the Security Forces also captured [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] in Theed.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace novelization" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of the south ridge appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', produced by [[Factor 5]] and [[LucasArts]]. The mission introduces the Naboo bomber into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]. The player, flying as Sykes, has several options to end the mission. The convoy can be destroyed outright or delayed by knocking down the pillars. If the player waits for Panaka's bomb, it automatically fails to go off and can be triggered by a bomb or laser blasts. If the player bombs the bridge without hitting the explosives, Palmer chastises the player, saying it will not work, and if the player destroys the bridge, the action triggers a glitch where the bridge is destroyed but the convoy drives over the bridge as if it is still there, and the mission ends in failure.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Additionally, the mission cannot be completed if the convoy reaches the other end of the bridge for any other reason, as the convoy can flank the Naboo forces. The player can also fail the mission if any of the Naboo airbase buildings are destroyed. Civilian losses in the first part of the mission do not affect the outcome. The Gian speeder and the Naboo bomber are the default crafts for the mission; additional playthroughs may be done with other ground and air vehicles.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

There is a discrepancy as to where the convoy is heading. ''Star Wars: Battle for Naboo'' indicates that the convoy is heading for Theed,<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> but the [[2003]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' establishes that Army C is a flanking force for the Battle of Grassy Plains. This article follows the latter source.<ref name="NEGTVAV" />

Storyboards for the mission's ending cutscene by artist [[James Zhang]] were included in the 2008 reference book ''[[Rogue Leaders: The Story of LucasArts]]''.<ref name="Rogue Leaders">''[[Rogue Leaders: The Story of LucasArts]]''</ref>
